fog_hollow_drake.note: The end of the cave: the way back closes and the fog gathers into the Fog Drake. Played on entering the hollow; the fight that follows is ordinary combat.

beats.text: The hollow is utterly still. The fog does not stir, and neither does anything else.
Behind you, the fog in the gallery mouth thickens into a grey wall, and the way back is gone.
Then, thread by thread, the fog begins to pull toward the middle of the hollow.
It thickens as it comes, and coils, and something vast turns over inside it.
[[RED]]A Fog Drake uncoils from the mist, and looks at you.[[/]]

drake_unravels.note: The Fog Drake falls: the way out of the hollow opens, and something far away begins to toll.

beats.text: The Fog Drake comes apart into long grey ribbons, and the whole hollow lets out its breath.
Far down in the valley, a single bell begins to toll.
Where the fog has drawn back from the far wall, a way down the valley side shows itself.

warn_pool.note: The first warning, told when the player first tries to go south from the Crystal Pool; the next try goes through.

beats.text: A draught climbs the passage, cold as a held breath. In it, so faint you could take it for your own breathing: [[YELLOW]]turn back[[/]].
[[YELLOW]]There is nothing down there that you want. Leave this place.[[/]]
The passage waits. If you have anything left to do, or to gather, do it now. If you mean to go on, go on.

warn_ledge.note: The second warning, on the Narrow Ledge; the next try south goes through.

beats.text: The fog below the ledge is not drifting any more. It is listening.
[[YELLOW]]Go back. Go back to the light, and the road, and whatever you left there.[[/]]
[[YELLOW]]Nobody who goes on comes back the way they came.[[/]]

warn_final.note: The last warning, in the Fog Gallery; the next try south goes through, into the hollow.

beats.text: The fog presses close, and your own footsteps are gone from the air.
[[RED]]The hollow will not let you leave. One of you will be finished there, and it will not be the fog.[[/]]
This is your last chance to turn back.
